question: Should removed-plugin doctor cleanup stay limited to the current shared stale-plugin surfaces, or may it also delete persisted `plugins.installs` records and matching `plugins.load.paths`?
rationale: Deleting install/load-path state changes upgrade behavior beyond the current shared repair path, and this protected maintainer PR needs owner intent before that compatibility risk is accepted.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase
options.body: Move any accepted cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave persisted install/load-path records untouched unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

options.title: Accept Broader Pruning
options.body: Keep install/load-path deletion only after maintainers accept the upgrade semantics and require live `openclaw doctor --fix` proof on an upgraded config.

options.title: Pause As Mostly Covered
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged if current main's generic stale-plugin cleanup is sufficient for the original warning path.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase
recommendation.body: Move any accepted cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave persisted install/load-path records untouched unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: She introduced the current shared stale-plugin doctor repair path that owns this cleanup surface.
